issues.summary: Add wrap-text toggle to Markdown inline code blocks
issues.description: Implements go-gitea/gitea#35314. Adds a client-side 'Toggle code wrap' button next to the existing copy-code button on every rendered Markdown code block, using the already-shipped .code-overflow-wrap/.code-overflow-scroll CSS classes (web_src/css/markup/content.css lines 377-392), with a localUserSettings-backed persisted preference. Prior art: draft PR go-gitea/gitea#35529 (unmerged).

Acceptance criteria: makeCodeBlockButton() helper exported and used by the existing copy button with no behavior change; new icon renders via svg('material-wrap-text'); window.config.i18n.code_toggle_wrap resolves to the new locale string.
